summary: Long retro pad (openDAW's Neon preset): slow 80s synth pad for synthwave, ambient, dream pop
label: Long Pad
body: Long held chords in MIDI 48-76, a bar or more each.

Register: MIDI 36-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Long Pad, openDAW's factory preset for Neon: make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Long Pad") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
